Lemma
[normalization of a partition of unity]

1. ch0:5.6Let $\{ f_\alpha \} $ be a differentiable partition of unity on $M$ subordinate to a covering of a set $s\subseteq M$. Then $\sum _\alpha f_\alpha (p)=1$ for every $p\in s$.
Proof

\sketch

This is condition (3) in the definition of a differentiable partition of unity: the family is locally finite, so the sum is finite at each point, and by definition it takes the value $1$ throughout the covered set $s$.

□
